contract.execution: Consume matching supplied completed batches once, synchronously; shared found/offset cursor, nonconsuming register/count/flag/reference reads
contract.outputs: Exact disjoint typed references, sparse view indexes and measurement prefixes; preflight all outputs before cursor/bank mutation; unknown tails retained
contract.registers: Explicit vision bank, detached complete XYZWPR poses and metadata; selected caller-root position-register group, finite additive X/Y adjustment
contract.parameters: Saved values, persistent CSAPI edits and explicit named one-shot override bindings; capture effective run parameters without recalculating supplied results
contract.persistence: Remaining batches, active results/cursors, parameter banks, references and bounded history; no native session, executable state or silent replay
contract.declarations: Lower only three exact documented INTEGER-returning IRVUTILVR prototypes; local routines/other owners retain ordinary linkage
contract.statuses: Portable 0/1/2/3/4 plus documented 12311 absent register view and 117151 no more results

discrepancies.manual: Parameter table labels num_values input REAL; purpose/details describe a returned count
discrepancies.decision: Require writable REAL output and retain this discrepancy for future native/strict work

boundaries: No camera/controller connection, image processing, calibration, native graphics, image register/file or reader/view-line operations
No asynchronous processing delay, native ABI/status equivalence, conveyor/legacy vision queues or controller acceptance
V_RUN_FIND zero view accepted only for a single configured view; TESTRUN zero selects all; script selection must match
GET_FOUND/GET_OFFSET share a portable cursor; reference scores/order and metadata are explicitly supplied, not acquired
